description: List Slack channels in the organization's connected workspaces, marking the ones Databuddy posts investigations to. Use set_slack_channel to connect or remove one.

search.description: Only channels whose name contains this text.

name: list_slack_channels

outputSchema.description: Up to 100 channels, connected first; a channel shared by two connected workspaces is listed once per workspace. problem says why a connected channel gets no posts. name is null for a connected channel Slack no longer lists. A private channel can be connected only after someone invites the Databuddy app to it in Slack.

title: List slack channels
